يقتضيا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَضِيَا (yaqtaḍiyā) /jaq.ta.dˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# يُقْتَضَيَا (yuqtaḍayā) /juq.ta.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
